from nltk.corpus import stopwords

stop_words = set(stopwords.words('english'))
lemmatizer = WordNetLemmatizer()

def preprocess(text):
    lemmatized = [lemmatizer.lemmatize(w.lower()) for w in text.split()]
    return ' '.join(list(set([w for w in lemmatized if w.lower() not in stop_words and len(w) > 2])))
